title: Ribbon runs: Total receipt
summary: A run is a maximal consecutive group of identical characters. Produce its length for each run, from left to right. Spaces are characters too. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence.
descriptionMd:
A sticking key leaves repeated marks across a typewriter ribbon's inspection strip. Ivo is closing the print-room account before the afternoon mail. A single total must replace the pile of working slips.

A run is a maximal consecutive group of identical characters. Produce its length for each run, from left to right. Spaces are characters too.

Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement ribbonRunsTotalReceipt(line, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: String runs. A run is a maximal consecutive group of identical characters. Produce its length for each run, from left to right. Spaces are characters too. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys (earlier units are used while the first two levels establish the foundations).
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
The line contains ASCII characters; the only word separator is a space.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with string runs. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

A run is a maximal consecutive group of identical characters. Produce its length for each run, from left to right. Spaces are characters too. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [1,1,2,1,1,3,1,1,1]. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 12.
The derived sequence is [2,1,1,2]. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 6.
The derived sequence is []. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 0.

overview: Variation: String runs. Build the sequence once, then report exactly what the inspection card requests.
